dict.string: ZAP talks to your Fire TV on your local network to send remote-control commands, and looks for an AirPlay receiver for screen mirroring.

ZAP uses the microphone only while you hold push-to-talk: to recognise voice commands on this Mac or, in Alexa mode, to send your voice through the Fire TV to Amazon's Alexa service. Nothing is recorded or stored.
ZAP turns what you say while holding push-to-talk into remote commands. Recognition runs on this Mac; Apple's servers are used only if you allow it in Settings.
